title: No stylesheet rule in Platform's shell uses display: contents or :has()
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects no `display: contents` and no `:has()`. Then opens a record page and expects its Children section's Expand all inside the section's own header row.

title: A record page's Expand all sits in its own section's header row, laid out in the markup
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects no `display: contents` and no `:has()`. Then opens a record page and expects its Children section's Expand all inside the section's own header row.

title: No selector in Platform's stylesheet names only elements, beyond the base styles
when: Reads every style rule in `app/src/styles.css` (not keyframe steps).
then: Expects each selector to name a class, attribute or ID, unless it names only base elements.

title: The exploring views' style rules select by class, attribute or ID
when: Reads every style rule in `app/src/styles.css` (not keyframe steps).
then: Expects each selector to name a class, attribute or ID, unless it names only base elements.

title: No style rule outside :root holds a hex, rgb() or hsl() color
then: Expects no hex, `rgb()` or `hsl()` value in any style rule outside `:root`, and no color in a component's inline style.

title: No component of the exploring views sets a color in its inline style
then: Expects no hex, `rgb()` or `hsl()` value in any style rule outside `:root`, and no color in a component's inline style.

title: Generic components import only React, React DOM and each other
when: Reads every file in `app/src/components`.
then: Expects imports only from React, React DOM and the same folder.

title: Generic components import nothing of the spec pages, the graph or the data types
when: Reads every file in `app/src/components`.
then: Expects imports only from React, React DOM and the same folder.

title: Platform's code lowercases kind labels only through lowerLabel(), never toLowerCase()
when: Reads the app's source, apart from `plural.ts`.
then: Expects no template or sum that adds an "s" to a label. It also expects no label lowercased by hand with `toLowerCase()`.

title: The exploring views make kind labels plural only through plural(), never by adding an s
when: Reads the app's source, apart from `plural.ts`.
then: Expects no template or sum that adds an "s" to a label. It also expects no label lowercased by hand with `toLowerCase()`.

title: Every button and link of Platform's shell on the main pages has an accessible name
when: Opens the product list, a domain page, a record page and a record's graph.
then: Expects every visible button, link and form control to have an accessible name.

title: Every button, link and form control on the domain and record pages and the graph has an accessible name
when: Opens the product list, a domain page, a record page and a record's graph.
then: Expects every visible button, link and form control to have an accessible name.

title: Platform's code, the engine and the READMEs use American spelling
when: Reads the app and engine source, every data file and the READMEs.
then: Expects none of a list of British spellings (`aria-labelledby` excepted).

title: The exploring views' code and UI text, and every data file, use American spelling
when: Reads the app and engine source, every data file and the READMEs.
then: Expects none of a list of British spellings (`aria-labelledby` excepted).

title: Every grid in Platform's shell says its columns, a single column being minmax(0, 1fr)
when: Reads every style rule.
then: Expects each grid, other than a centering icon grid, to declare its columns.

title: Every grid on the exploring pages says its columns, so content shrinks with its panel
when: Reads every style rule.
then: Expects each grid, other than a centering icon grid, to declare its columns.

title: Each built-in theme's stylesheet sets only custom properties on :root and passes AA in both modes
when: Reads every built-in theme file.
then: Expects only token names the stylesheet's `:root` defines; expects each theme's stylesheet to have only `:root` selectors and custom properties; and computes the contrast of ink, muted text and the accent on paper and sheet for every built-in in both modes.

title: No built-in theme file names a token the stylesheet's :root does not define
when: Reads every built-in theme file.
then: Expects only token names the stylesheet's `:root` defines; expects each theme's stylesheet to have only `:root` selectors and custom properties; and computes the contrast of ink, muted text and the accent on paper and sheet for every built-in in both modes.

title: Only address.ts builds a record or group address in the app's and the desktop's source
when: Reads every source file in `app/src` and `desktop/src` except `address.ts`.
then: Expects no path built by hand under `/records`, `/specs` or `/graph`, nor a template starting `/${…}`. Expects every app page's first word to be lowercase and never an ID, `/` to be the products, an ID to be a product, domain or record page and an ID with a kind a group. Then renders the products, a product, a domain, a record, a group, Checks, the format and Appearance, and expects every in-app link to be `/`, an app page or an ID.

title: Every in-app link on the exploring pages is /, a lowercase app page or an ID
when: Reads every source file in `app/src` and `desktop/src` except `address.ts`.
then: Expects no path built by hand under `/records`, `/specs` or `/graph`, nor a template starting `/${…}`. Expects every app page's first word to be lowercase and never an ID, `/` to be the products, an ID to be a product, domain or record page and an ID with a kind a group. Then renders the products, a product, a domain, a record, a group, Checks, the format and Appearance, and expects every in-app link to be `/`, an app page or an ID.

title: No line of the app or the engine says legacy, redirect or alias
when: Reads every source file in `app/src` and `lathe/src`.
then: Expects no line that says legacy, redirect or alias, naming the file and line of each, and exactly one declaration of `addressOf`, taking the ID alone.

title: addressOf is declared once, taking the ID alone
when: Reads every source file in `app/src` and `lathe/src`.
then: Expects no line that says legacy, redirect or alias, naming the file and line of each, and exactly one declaration of `addressOf`, taking the ID alone.

title: knip finds no unused file, export or dependency in the app, the engine or the desktop app
when: Runs knip in `app/`, `lathe/` and `desktop/`, each with its own `knip.json`.
then: Expects it to report nothing.
notes: Also: T130 `unused-css.test.ts`, T131 and T132 `commands-and-icons-used.test.ts`, T133 and T134 `marks-have-meaning.test.tsx`

title: knip finds no unused file, export or dependency in the app, which holds the Explorer's code
when: Runs knip in `app/`, `lathe/` and `desktop/`, each with its own `knip.json`.
then: Expects it to report nothing.
notes: Also: T130 `unused-css.test.ts`, T131 and T132 `commands-and-icons-used.test.ts`, T133 and T134 `marks-have-meaning.test.tsx`

title: The shared hover tokens are defined in :root
when: Reads every style rule in `app/src/styles.css` that sets a pointer cursor.
then: Expects a `:hover` rule naming the same class, and expects the shared hover tokens to be defined.

title: Every pointer-cursor rule has a :hover rule for the same class
when: Reads every style rule in `app/src/styles.css` that sets a pointer cursor.
then: Expects a `:hover` rule naming the same class, and expects the shared hover tokens to be defined.

title: The shell, gap and radius tokens are defined, and no separator is drawn outside ResizeHandle
then: Expects the shell, gap and radius tokens, no separator drawn outside ResizeHandle, and on a record with the wiki and graph open the navigation, the gap between the panes and the side bar as resize handles beside panels.

title: On a record with the wiki and graph open, every gap between panels is a resize handle
then: Expects the shell, gap and radius tokens, no separator drawn outside ResizeHandle, and on a record with the wiki and graph open the navigation, the gap between the panes and the side bar as resize handles beside panels.

title: One page bar sits outside every pane, holding the tab strip and the one View group
when: Opens a record alone, with the wiki and graph, and with both on a phone.
then: Expects one page bar, outside every pane and the side bar, holding the tab strip at its left (on a phone, the Open pages button instead), and at its right the one "View" group of `aria-pressed` toggles, one pressed per shown pane, with the side bar toggle last. On a wide screen each pane is a panel whose first child is its slim header: a non-interactive label naming its view, and only its close button (when more than one pane is open) and its full screen button, all icon buttons, with no tabs or groups in it. On a phone one pane shows, with no header. The title sits in the leftmost pane, and the stylesheet gives the page bar and the pane headers fixed heights.

title: Each pane's header holds only its view's label and its close and full screen buttons, and a phone shows none
when: Opens a record alone, with the wiki and graph, and with both on a phone.
then: Expects one page bar, outside every pane and the side bar, holding the tab strip at its left (on a phone, the Open pages button instead), and at its right the one "View" group of `aria-pressed` toggles, one pressed per shown pane, with the side bar toggle last. On a wide screen each pane is a panel whose first child is its slim header: a non-interactive label naming its view, and only its close button (when more than one pane is open) and its full screen button, all icon buttons, with no tabs or groups in it. On a phone one pane shows, with no header. The title sits in the leftmost pane, and the stylesheet gives the page bar and the pane headers fixed heights.

title: Motion is shared and optional: every transition and animation uses the motion or hover tokens and is turned off under reduced motion
when: Reads every style rule in `app/src/styles.css` that sets a transition or animation.
then: Expects its times and easing to come from `--motion-speed`, `--motion-ease` or `--hover-speed`, and each such selector to be turned off by a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` rule or to apply only under `no-preference`. Expects the tokens to be defined, and code that animates frame by frame to take its timing from `readMotion()`, which reads them and checks `prefers-reduced-motion`.

title: The glide follows the shared easing: CSS's ease, read from the motion tokens
then: Checks the easing curve against CSS's ease walked finely, a pan halfway through the time most of the way there, and the motion tokens parsed as the stylesheet writes them.

title: The row link's ::after stretches over its row, with the row's other controls above it
when: Renders a domain page and a record page.
then: Expects every row of every `record-list` (each tree item's own row, and each plain row) that holds a record link to have exactly one `row-link`, a real link to a record's page. Reads `app/src/styles.css` and expects the `row-link` `::after` to be absolute with `inset: 0`, the rows to be `position: relative`, the row's other controls to sit above it with a `z-index`, and the link to give the row a hover tint and a focus ring.

title: Every record row on the domain and record pages has exactly one row link to its record
when: Renders a domain page and a record page.
then: Expects every row of every `record-list` (each tree item's own row, and each plain row) that holds a record link to have exactly one `row-link`, a real link to a record's page. Reads `app/src/styles.css` and expects the `row-link` `::after` to be absolute with `inset: 0`, the rows to be `position: relative`, the row's other controls to sit above it with a `z-index`, and the link to give the row a hover tint and a focus ring.

title: A reload brings back the same tabs in order, the preview and the active tab
when: Opens three tabs, two kept and one preview, with different views, activates the first, and reloads the app at the same address.
then: Expects the same tabs in order, the same preview and active tab, the first tab's two panes, and the second tab's wiki alone when activated.

title: A reload brings back each tab's own views
when: Opens three tabs, two kept and one preview, with different views, activates the first, and reloads the app at the same address.
then: Expects the same tabs in order, the same preview and active tab, the first tab's two panes, and the second tab's wiki alone when activated.

title: On a coarse pointer every clickable control of Platform's shell is at least 44 × 44 px
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects every rule with a pointer cursor to be covered by a coarse-pointer rule that sizes the control (or a `::before` stretched around it) to `--touch-target` (44 px), or to be touch-sized everywhere; canvas nodes and cards are exempt, being laid out large and zoomable.

title: On a coarse pointer every clickable control of the exploring pages is at least 44 × 44 px, canvases exempt
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects every rule with a pointer cursor to be covered by a coarse-pointer rule that sizes the control (or a `::before` stretched around it) to `--touch-target` (44 px), or to be touch-sized everywhere; canvas nodes and cards are exempt, being laid out large and zoomable.

title: Nothing jumps, in the source: scroll boxes keep their gutter, bars have one height, counts are one text, canvases stay mounted
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects every vertical scroll box to set `scrollbar-gutter: stable` or hide its scrollbar, and the pane title above a canvas, the graph's trail and toolbar, and the ERD view's caption and key to have a fixed block size or be one line. Renders the graph and expects its count to be one text after the depth, and its canvas to stay mounted when it re-centers. Reads the graph and ERD view sources and expects what the graph connects to reach the host in a layout effect, and the ERD to be fitted before paint and to observe its size once. Moves to a record from outside the nav and expects the nav's domain row to stay closed and be marked, and opening it to open the branch down to the page. Reads `app/index.html` and `app/src/fonts.css` and expects no Google Fonts, the six latin files preloaded, every face `font-display: optional`, and each family's license beside its files.
notes: Also: the stability suite's scenarios (T71 to T78, T80, T81, T89, `LA-V93-R16-T03`, `T175`, `T202`), most of which are also the Workbench's view tests

title: Stability: focusing anything moves the camera only, and no box changes its place or size
when: Focuses a domain, a stage, a folder, a capability and a use case by clicking, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects each step stable, the camera different at each, and every box seen to keep the same place and size in the map throughout.

title: Every raw button outside Button.tsx is one of the allowed controls, in the source and on the pages
when: Renders the products, product, domain, record, graph.
then: Checks, format and appearance pages and expects no `button.secondary` or `.tree-bulk`, no paragraph whose only content is a plain link (a standalone link must be drawn as a button; a record's own ID line is a reference), and every `<button>` to be the `Button` component's or one of the allowed controls: tab close buttons, toggles in a group, fold chevrons, the nav's rows and rail, the sheet handle, the open-pages list, the title bar's command center and the canvas library's zoom controls. Then reads the source for the same: no `secondary` or `tree-bulk` class, and every raw `<button>` outside `Button.tsx` one of those controls, none taking the Button's own classes except the view toggles, which take the icon look on a wide screen and a segment's on a phone.

title: No paragraph on the main pages holds only a plain link: a standalone action is a button
when: Renders the products, product, domain, record, graph.
then: Checks, format and appearance pages and expects no `button.secondary` or `.tree-bulk`, no paragraph whose only content is a plain link (a standalone link must be drawn as a button; a record's own ID line is a reference), and every `<button>` to be the `Button` component's or one of the allowed controls: tab close buttons, toggles in a group, fold chevrons, the nav's rows and rail, the sheet handle, the open-pages list, the title bar's command center and the canvas library's zoom controls. Then reads the source for the same: no `secondary` or `tree-bulk` class, and every raw `<button>` outside `Button.tsx` one of those controls, none taking the Button's own classes except the view toggles, which take the icon look on a wide screen and a segment's on a phone.

then: Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the side bar sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and expects axe-core to find nothing.

title: Accessibility: the Explorer's pages (domain, record, group, graph and ERD view) pass axe at WCAG 2.2 AA, at both widths, in every look

title: Performance: the first load ships 250 KB of JavaScript or less
when: Builds the app for production.

title: Only boxes in view and big enough are drawn, each with its label, with bars for the rest, within a budget
when: Frames a domain.
then: Expects only boxes in view and at least 3 pixels tall, each drawn as its ID alone (its label always drawn); far out, no box too small and a bar for each run of tiny children inside its parent's span; a forced box drawn whatever its size; the same view drawing the same; and a synthetic product of more than 3,000 nodes within the budget at every zoom.

title: In the Tree, Nested and Voronoi layouts, at every domain, stage and folder of every product, at depths 1 to 3 in two panes, siblings share one size and text scale and every drawn box shows its name
when: Loads the repo's own specs (Lathe and the Tool Library), and for each layout and product frames every domain, stage and folder group at depths 1, 2 and 3 in a 770 by 640 and a 1200 by 800 pane with the real camera.
then: Expects the siblings in each map to be the same size (Voronoi cells within 10% of each other's area) with one text scale, every drawn box's label lines to give back its title and its kind and ID line, and the label to fit its box at its scale (a Voronoi cell's inside its outline). On a failure it names the layout, focus, depth, pane, box and its size on screen.

title: Each label line is placed in map units at its face's size times its box's text scale, inside its box, and drawn at that size times the zoom
when: For every box of the Tree, Nested and Voronoi maps of the test workspace.
then: Expects each label line's size to be its face's at text scale 1 times the box's text scale, and the whole line inside its box (a cell's inside its polygon), and every badge inside its box. On the page, expects each drawn line's font on screen to be its map size times the zoom, and a line under `TEXT_BAR_PX` drawn as a bar. Expects the canvas's measure to read each width once at its face's font, and the plain measure to be the same every time.
